Band A/B: Site and MODX

Whole-band examples in a dozen styles, switched between the site’s samples and the MODX while they play, to choose which sounds better for each style.

Each example below is the Backing Track band in one style. Press ▶ Play, then flip Site and MODX while it plays (or press m), or tick Switch every … bars to hear them take turns. Mark which sounds better under each one; the tally is at the top. The MODX plays each instrument on its Part of the Site Band Performance and the drums on the kit for that style (set on Play the Band on the MODX); an instrument with no Part stays on the site.

Connect and switch

Not connected

The automatic switch times bars from the tempo, not from the band itself, so it can land a little off the barline. Set the MODX's timing offset on the MODX page first, or the two will not line up.

So far:

Swing

Walking upright bass, piano, ride time on the jazz kit (BeechwoodSnare).

Jazz ballad

Bass in two, piano pads; the drums on the jazz kit.

Bossa nova

Cross-stick bossa on the jazz kit, nylon or jazz guitar on the site, piano.

Son montuno

The clave groove on the jazz kit and the tumbao on the Pop Latin Kit’s congas (channel 9).

Jump blues

Boogie bass and a shuffle on the jazz kit.

Straight-eighth rock

Rock Stereo Kit 1 (channel 14), electric bass.

Rock, distorted guitar

The same with the distorted guitar comping (channel 5).

Acoustic strum

Steel-string guitar (channel 11), the pop kit (Dry Standard, channel 15).

Piano ballad

Piano (channel 7) and the pop kit.

Motown / soul

Snare on every beat on the pop kit, electric bass.

Soul with organ

The Motown groove with the tonewheel organ comping (channel 3; the MODX’s rotary speed on the CC set on the MODX page).

Dance pop

Four on the floor on the pop kit.

Dance pop on Rhodes

The same with the Rhodes comping (channel 8).

Reggaeton

Dembow on the R&B kit (channel 16).

Folk carol (brushes)

Brushes on the Brush Kit (channel 12).

Funk on Wurlitzer

A Wurlitzer comping (channel 2) over the soul band; switch the groove to Funk below to hear the R&B kit.
